title: Hinglish Sentiment — TF-IDF Baseline vs IndicBERT with ONNX Export

modules.dataset: Hinglish code-mixed ETL: script detection (Roman/Devanagari/Mixed), text normalization (URL/mention stripping + Hinglish romanization lookup + Devanagari preservation), synthetic review generator with 3-class sentiment lexicon, HFDatasetWrapper for tokenized batching, stratified train/val/test splits.
modules.model: Two model families via one API: TF-IDF + LogisticRegression baseline (word n-grams 1-2, sublinear TF) vs fine-tuned IndicBERT (bert-base-multilingual-cased fallback; ai4bharat/indic-bert gated). ClassificationMetrics value object with confusion matrix + ROC-AUC + log-loss. ONNX export via torch.onnx with dynamic batch axis.
modules.tests: 18 tests (16 by default + 2 opt-in BERT): script detection (4 cases), text normalization (6 cases), synthetic dataset + splits, HF Dataset wrapper tokenization, TF-IDF training + metrics sanity, IndicBERT fine-tuning + ONNX runtime parity (max proba diff <1e-3), CLI smoke.

entry_point: python train.py [--models tfidf_logreg indicbert] [--csv data.csv] [--epochs 3] --onnx-out models/indicbert.onnx
